title: Double the radius, not the volume
hook: Two ideal cylinders have equal height and radii of 3cm and 6cm.

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Predict cylinder capacity scaling when radius doubles at fixed height.

misconception: Doubling radius only doubles an ideal cylinder’s capacity.
objective: Predict cylinder capacity scaling when radius doubles at fixed height.

claims.text: Ideal cylinders have inner radii 3cm and 6cm; both have inner height 10cm. Scaled model; ideal cylinders; V=πr²h; 1000cm³/L.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Height=10cm, A=0.283L and B=1.131L. Geometry follows the declared dimension relationships. Other pictures use a fixed full scale across the slider range; continuous fills and arcs show relative amounts rather than literal object counts.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["/",["*",3.141592653589793,9,"x"],1000]; B=["/",["*",3.141592653589793,36,"x"],1000]; x denotes Height. At x=10, A=0.282743338823, B=1.13097335529; recall at x=13: B=1.47026536188. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals. Energy axis endpoints use resourceAxisEnd, including B=5×A hours in lh-watts-hours-trade; cylinder rx and ry both scale with radius in resourceCylinderDimensions. claims.text: Cylinder capacity depends on radius squared. Doubling radius multiplies the circular base area by four; equal height then gives four times the volume. The dimensions here are ideal internal measurements.
